description: Failure-handler ingress matrix, instance leg pinned to a return-string handler with a distinctive payload. Identical catalog to ingress-matrix-handler-default. The payload text is what makes an instance-versus-per-call return-string pair discriminating even though both sides share a behavior name. Cases on this fixture use `get` wherever the responding handler returns a string, because DefaultStrings.java:758 sets TranslationResultStatus.RETURNED_STRING and the corpus schema's translationResult.status enum admits only TRANSLATED and RETURNED_KEY.
